article.question: Does Fast Cleaner treat similar photos as files I should delete?

source.title: Merge duplicate photos and videos
source.fact: Apple’s Duplicates feature offers a merge workflow for identified groups. A cleaner’s similar-image suggestions are a separate reason to inspect the content.

article.claim_scope: Official guidance supports platform facts. Fast Cleaner descriptions rely on its developer disclosures and existing store/product assets; no independent performance or security test is claimed.
